block.comedymonkeysaddons.wellspring.too: A _sealed reservoir_ for _water_ or _lava_. Fit it with _upgrades_ and it will _generate_ its fluid endlessly.

Fills itself with _water_ (Water Upgrades) or _lava_ (Lava Upgrades). Up to _three_ of one kind can be installed, each one _increasing_ the generation speed. Up to _three_ Capacity Upgrades _enlarge_ the tank.
Fluid can be _pumped out_ from any side, or collected with a _bucket_. Comparators read the fill level.
R-Click with a Wrench (or Sneak + R-Click)
Opens the _upgrade GUI_ to add or remove upgrades.
item.comedymonkeysaddons.water_upgrade.t: A _hydraulic module_ for the _Fluid Wellspring_. Each one installed makes it generate _water_ faster.
Up to _three_ can be fitted. Cannot be mixed with _Lava Upgrades_.
item.comedymonkeysaddons.dripstone_upgra: A _geothermal module_ for the _Fluid Wellspring_. Each one installed makes it generate _lava_ faster.
Up to _three_ can be fitted. Cannot be mixed with _Water Upgrades_.

Up to three upgrades of one kind can be installed. Each lamp on top is one upgrade, and each one speeds up generation
The glass windows show the fill level. The notches on the frame mark 25%%, 50%% and 75%%

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.chest_upgrade: Increasing Chest and Barrel Capacity with Chest Upgrades
Chest upgrades let a chest hold more items in each slot
Right-click a chest with a Copper Chest Upgrade. It keeps its items and holds twice as many per slot
A higher tier replaces the current upgrade, which is handed back. Each tier doubles the stack size again
Copper x2, Iron x4 and Gold x8 per slot. Diamond keeps x8 but doubles the number of slots
Sneak and right-click the side of an upgraded chest while holding a chest to extend it into a double chest. One upgrade covers both halves
Right-click with a Wrench to open the upgrade screen. Taking the upgrade out turns it back into a normal chest
Barrels take the same upgrades, with the same tiers and rules
Hoppers, funnels and pipes fill upgraded chests and barrels all the way to their larger limit
They keep their contents on Create contraptions and Aeronautics physics objects, and can be picked up with Carry On
item.comedymonkeysaddons.fe_coil.tooltip: Copper wound on a _redstone core_: the part that lets a machine take _Forge Energy_.
_Trade Bot_, whose winding station charges him with FE.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.pressure_cruci: A _heavy press_ that squeezes _fine dust_ into _gems_ and _scrap_. Sits on a _Blaze Burner_ and takes a lot of _rotational force_.

Presses _9 Emerald Dust_ into an _Emerald_ over a _heated_ burner, and _9 Netherite Dust_ into _Netherite Scrap_ over a _superheated_ one. Also fuses _sand_ into _glass_, packs _gravel_ into _stone_, and with enough heat squeezes _coal_ into _diamonds_, _quartz_ into _amethyst_ and _cobblestone_ into _obsidian_. Faster rotation presses faster.
_Funnels_, hoppers and pipes can insert dust and extract the results from _any side_.
_Takes out_ the results (or the dust, if nothing has been pressed).
item.comedymonkeysaddons.emerald_dust.to: Glittering green powder, occasionally left behind when _Crushing Wheels_ or a _Millstone_ grind _cobblestone_ or _stone_.
_Nine_ of them become an _Emerald_ in a _Pressure Crucible_ over a _heated_ Blaze Burner.
Heavy, dark grains, very rarely left behind when _Crushing Wheels_ grind _netherrack_.
_Nine_ of them become _Netherite Scrap_ in a _Pressure Crucible_ over a _superheated_ Blaze Burner.
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.pressure_cruc: Pressing Dust into Emeralds and Netherite Scrap
The Pressure Crucible presses fine dust into gems and metal scrap
Crushing Wheels and Millstones have a small chance to turn cobblestone or stone into Emerald Dust. Crushing netherrack can give Netherite Dust
It needs rotational force, and a Blaze Burner underneath for heat
Nine Emerald Dust over a heated Blaze Burner are pressed into an Emerald
Right-click with an empty hand to take the results out. Funnels and other item transport can insert dust and extract results from any side
Netherite Dust needs a superheated Blaze Burner, fed with Blaze Cakes, and takes much longer to press
Nine Netherite Dust make one Netherite Scrap. Faster rotation presses faster, at a heavy stress cost
It also makes quick work of everyday blocks: sand is pressed into glass over a heated Blaze Burner...
...and gravel is packed back into stone, with no heat needed at all. Both take only a moment each
For a steady supply of netherrack, mix cobblestone with lava in a Basin over a heated Blaze Burner. A cobblestone generator can then feed both dusts

block.comedymonkeysaddons.andesite_cobbl: A sealed, lava-fed _cobblestone generator_ in one block. Makes one cobblestone each time a _Mechanical Drill_ at the same speed would mine one.
Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_ (the window faces you when placed). Faster rotation makes cobblestone faster. Holds a stack, then stops until it's emptied. The window shows it working.
Only comes out through _hoppers_, _chutes_, _funnels_, pipes or arms, from any side.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.brass_cobble_g: A sealed, lava-fed _cobblestone generator_ in one block. Makes _16 cobblestone_ each time a _Mechanical Drill_ at the same speed would mine one.
Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_ (the window faces you when placed). Faster rotation makes cobblestone faster. Holds four stacks, then stops until it's emptied. The window shows it working.
Only comes out through _hoppers_, _chutes_, _funnels_, pipes or arms, from any side.

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.cobble_genera: Meet the Cobblestone Generator: an entire cobblestone farm, squeezed into one block
Power it through the shaft hole in the back. Only the back! It's picky like that
Inside, water meets lava and out pops cobblestone, exactly as fast as a Mechanical Drill could mine it
It won't just hand it over, though. Hoppers, chutes, funnels or pipes have to come and get it
When it's full it simply stops, and stops using stress too. How considerate
A redstone signal switches it off as well
The Brass Cobblestone Generator makes sixteen at a time. Sixteen!
Craft either one with a Transmitter to go Wireless. Set a frequency on top, just like a Redstone Link...
...and switch it off from anywhere. Rocks, now with Wi-Fi

item.comedymonkeysaddons.quartz_dust.too: Pale, sparkly grit, sometimes left behind when _Crushing Wheels_ grind _netherrack_ or _blackstone_.
_Four_ make _Nether Quartz_ in a _Pressure Crucible_ over a _heated_ Blaze Burner.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.incinerator.to: A _bottomless furnace_ that _destroys_ every _item_ and _fluid_ put into it. Perfect for the overflow nobody wants.
_Funnels_, chutes, hoppers and _pipes_ can push anything in from _any side_: it is gone for good. Never fills up, never backs up.
While it is _burning_ something it _heats_ a _Steam Engine boiler_ above it like a lit _Blaze Burner_. It stays lit for _5 seconds_ after the last thing burns.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.magma_engine.t: A heavy _lava-burning engine_ with the power of _four Portable Engines_: _64 RPM_ and _8,192 stress units_ from a single block.
Burns _10 mB_ of _lava_ a second and turns the _shaft_ in the middle of its front. A _Fluid Wellspring_ with Lava Upgrades keeps it going forever.
The _shaft_ points at _you_, any way up; _sneak_ to point it _away_. _Pipes_ fill it on _any side but the front_, and it holds _4 buckets_.
_Pours_ the lava in, from any side.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.supercharged_m: A _Magma Engine_ rebuilt with a _Precision Mechanism_: twice as fast and twice as strong, _128 RPM_ and _16,384 stress units_ from a single block.
Burns _20 mB_ of _lava_ a second, twice a Magma Engine, and turns the _shaft_ in the middle of its front.
The _shaft_ points at _you_, any way up; _sneak_ to point it _away_. _Pipes_ fill it on _any side but the front_, and it holds _8 buckets_.
_Pours_ the lava in, from any side.
comedymonkeysaddons.gui.goggles.magma_en: Burning %s mB of lava a second
block.comedymonkeysaddons.compact_gyrosc: A _Gyroscope_ squeezed into _one block_: a flywheel in a _brass gimbal_ that stays level while the ship tilts round it, and keeps _Aeronautics ships level_.
Pushes the ship back _upright_ and _damps_ its wobble, exactly like the _Gyroscope_ it is made from. Reaches full strength at _256 RPM_. Takes a _shaft_ from above or below.
Made from a _Flywheel_, a _Precision Mechanism_, a _shaft_, _Brass Casing_ and _Framed Glass_. With _Gyroscope Stabilizers_ installed, its _Gyroscope_ also converts straight into one, and back.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.torque_rotor.t: A _propeller_ that _turns_ an _Aeronautics ship_ without pushing it: none of a tail propeller's _sideways drift_. The tail rotor your helicopter wanted.

Its blades push the way they _face_ (or pull, with the shaft reversed), turning the ship about its _centre of mass_ exactly as hard as an _Andesite Propeller_ in the same spot would, but the ship itself is _not pushed_. Mount it _far from the middle_, like a tail rotor: the further out, the harder it turns.

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.stone_generat: Basalt and Blackstone Generators work just like the Cobblestone ones, only here lava meets a block of blue ice
The Basalt Generator wears ice-blue trim and is crafted with Soul Soil. Basalt is soft, so at full speed it comes twice as fast
The Blackstone Generator is all black and gold, and is crafted with a block of Blackstone
Power goes in the back and the stone comes out through hoppers, chutes, funnels or pipes. Full or switched off by redstone, they rest
Brass versions make sixteen at a time, and a Transmitter makes any of them Wireless, just like the cobblestone kind
The Magma Engine: four Portable Engines' worth of muscle, in a single block
Pipe lava in on any side but the front, where the shaft is, or pour it in by the bucket. It holds four buckets
Burning 10 mB of lava a second, it turns its shaft at 64 RPM with a whopping 8,192 stress units to spare
Hook it up to a Fluid Wellspring with Lava Upgrades and it runs forever. Lava in, power out, not a lump of coal in sight
Run it dry and it stops. Engineer's Goggles show how much lava is left
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.incinerator.t: The Incinerator gets rid of anything you give it. No questions asked
Hoppers, chutes, funnels and arms can push items in from any side. It never fills up, so it never backs up
Pipes work too: any fluid piped in simply vanishes
It stays lit for a few seconds after the last thing burns...
...and while it's lit, it heats a Steam Engine boiler above it just like a lit Blaze Burner. Your rubbish, now a power source
comedymonkeysaddons.gui.goggles.compact_: Only works on an Aeronautics ship
block.comedymonkeysaddons.tuff_generator: A sealed _tuff generator_ in one block, where _lava_ meets _water_ over a bed of _gravel_. Makes one tuff each time a _Mechanical Drill_ at the same speed would mine one.
Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_ (the window faces you when placed). Faster rotation makes tuff faster. Holds a stack, then stops until it's emptied. The window shows it working.
Only comes out through _hoppers_, _chutes_, _funnels_, pipes or arms, from any side.
When Full or Powered by Redstone
_Stops_, and puts _no stress_ on the network until it's emptied or the signal is removed.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.wireless_tuff_: A sealed _tuff generator_ in one block, where _lava_ meets _water_ over a bed of _gravel_. Makes one tuff each time a _Mechanical Drill_ at the same speed would mine one.
Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_ (the window faces you when placed). Faster rotation makes tuff faster. Holds a stack, then stops until it's emptied. The window shows it working.
Only comes out through _hoppers_, _chutes_, _funnels_, pipes or arms, from any side.
When Full or Powered by Redstone
_Stops_, and puts _no stress_ on the network until it's emptied or the signal is removed.
Its _antenna_ listens like a _Redstone Link_: set the _frequency_ with the two slots on top. A signal on it _switches the generator off_.
advancements.comedymonkeysaddons.tuff_ge: Craft a Tuff Generator. When the going gets tuff, the tuff get generating
block.comedymonkeysaddons.string_tangler: A copper-trimmed machine that _tangles string_ into _cobwebs_. Watch the whisk spin the string off its spools and ball it up into a web.
Twists _4 string_ and _1 slime ball_ into a _cobweb_. Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_; faster rotation tangles faster.
_Hoppers_, funnels and pipes can feed both ingredients and take the cobwebs from _any side_.
_Loads_ it. With an empty hand, _takes_ the cobwebs out.
Infuses _cobblestone_ with _metal nuggets_ to make Create's _ore-bearing stones_: _asurine_, _crimsite_, _ochrum_ and _veridium_. Watch the metal dust fall on the turning stone as the new stone creeps up it.
_Cobblestone_ with _9 zinc nuggets_ makes _asurine_, _9 iron_ makes _crimsite_, _9 gold_ makes _ochrum_ and _9 copper_ makes _veridium_. Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_.
_Hoppers_, funnels and pipes can feed both ingredients and take the stone from _any side_.
_Loads_ it. With an empty hand, _takes_ the stone out.
advancements.comedymonkeysaddons.string_: Craft a String Tangler. Charlotte would be proud
advancements.comedymonkeysaddons.stone_i: Craft a Stone Infuser. Cobblestone with ambition
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.string_tangle: The String Tangler twists string and slime into cobwebs
Give it rotation through the shaft hole in its back
Every cobweb takes four string and a slime ball. Hoppers, funnels and pipes can load both from any side
Watch the whisk wind the string off its spools and ball it up into a web
Pull the cobwebs out from any side, or take them by hand. Spider-free, guaranteed
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.stone_infuser: The Stone Infuser turns cobblestone into Create's ore-bearing stones
Power it through its back and feed it cobblestone and nine nuggets for each stone. Zinc nuggets make asurine...
...iron nuggets make crimsite, gold makes ochrum and copper makes veridium
Crush the stone again and some nuggets come back, never as many as went in. Crushing tuff gives a few of all four
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.tuff_generato: The Tuff Generator works just like a Cobblestone Generator, but lava meets water over a bed of gravel, and out comes tuff
Power it from the back and collect from any side. Full, or switched off by redstone, it rests and uses no stress
Craft it with a Transmitter to make it Wireless, and switch it off from anywhere on its frequency
item.comedymonkeysaddons.netherite_chest: Turns a _chest_ or _barrel_ into a _Netherite_ one: Diamond's _doubled slots_ with _16x_ as many items per slot, and it _shrugs off explosions_.
When used on a chest or barrel
Works on _vanilla chests and barrels_, and on upgraded ones of a _lower tier_, which hand back their old upgrade. _One_ upgrade covers a whole _double chest_.
Sneak + R-Click a chest's side with a chest
Extends a single upgraded chest into a _double chest_ of the same tier, sharing its upgrade.
R-Click an upgraded chest or barrel with a Wrench
Opens its _upgrade screen_ (sneak + R-Click with an upgrade also works).
advancements.comedymonkeysaddons.netheri: Upgrade a chest to Netherite. A thousand to a slot, and it laughs at creepers

Take out only what you already carry
comedymonkeysaddons.gui.quick_transfer.w: Scroll over a slot to move one item at a time
item.comedymonkeysaddons.honey_upgrade.t: A rare _honey module_ for the _Fluid Wellspring_. Each one installed makes it generate Create's _honey_, which turns to _limestone_ where it meets _lava_.
Up to _three_ can be fitted. Cannot be mixed with other _generation upgrades_.
item.comedymonkeysaddons.chocolate_upgra: A rare _chocolate module_ for the _Fluid Wellspring_. Each one installed makes it generate Create's _chocolate_, which turns to _scoria_ where it meets _lava_.
Up to _three_ can be fitted. Cannot be mixed with other _generation upgrades_.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.flight_instrum: A sloping cockpit desk for _Aeronautics ships_ with four live gauges: an _altimeter_, _airspeed_ indicator, _artificial horizon_ and _heading_ indicator.
Faces you. The way you face the panel counts as the ship's _forward_, for heading and pitch.
With Goggles or a Display Link
_Engineer's Goggles_ show every reading. A _Display Link_ can put _altitude_, _airspeed_, _climb_, _heading_ or _attitude_ on a display.
advancements.comedymonkeysaddons.flight_: Craft Flight Instruments. Now you know exactly how lost you are
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.compact_gyros: The Compact Gyroscope: a whole Gyroscope Stabilizer, squeezed into one framed glass block
Spin it with a shaft from above or below. The faster it spins, the harder it works, up to 256 RPM
On an Aeronautics ship, whenever something tips it over...
...it pushes back upright and calms the wobble until the ship sits level again
Craft it from a Flywheel, a Precision Mechanism, a shaft, Brass Casing and Framed Glass. Have Gyroscope Stabilizers? Its Gyroscope converts straight into one
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.flight_instru: Flight Instruments read the ship they're on: altitude, airspeed, attitude and heading, each on its own dial
Place it facing you in the cockpit: the way you face the panel is taken as the ship's forward
Engineer's Goggles show every reading, and a Display Link can put any of them on a Display Board or Nixie Tubes
The Torque Rotor looks like a propeller, but it turns a ship instead of pushing it along
It mounts on the face you click, with the shaft going in through its base
Its blades push the way they face, swinging the ship round its centre of mass just as a propeller there would...
...but without dragging the ship sideways. Just what a helicopter's tail needs
Reverse the shaft to turn the other way. Mounted further from the middle, it turns harder

block.comedymonkeysaddons.supercharged_m: Sets which way the _shaft_ turns, _clockwise_ or _counter-clockwise_.
item.comedymonkeysaddons.snug_pipez_cove: A copycat cover for _Pipez_ pipes that hugs the _pipe_, a pixel proud of it all round, following every arm. Dress it in any _full block_ to hide your pipework. The pipe keeps working underneath.
_Fits_ the cover. Using the other kind of cover _swaps_ it.
_Dresses_ the cover in that block (one is used, and given back when changed).
item.comedymonkeysaddons.full_pipez_cove: A copycat cover for _Pipez_ pipes that fills the _whole block_, which becomes solid to walk on and build against. Dress it in any _full block_ to hide your pipework. The pipe keeps working underneath.
_Fits_ the cover. Using the other kind of cover _swaps_ it.
_Dresses_ the cover in that block (one is used, and given back when changed).
block.comedymonkeysaddons.compact_gyrosc: _Brakes_ the flywheel: the _stronger_ the signal, the _slower_ it spins and the less it holds the ship. A _full_ signal stops it.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.electric_motor: Turns _Forge Energy_ into rotation: fast, and strong enough to rival a _full steam boiler_.

Turns its _shaft_ at the set _speed_ with the set _stress capacity_, up to _294,912 SU_. The more stress it's set to give, the more _FE_ it draws. Power goes in through its _base_, opposite the shaft.
Opens its settings: _speed_ (Create's standard speeds), _stress_ (in steps of what the generators make) and _direction_.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.lava_generator: A small _lava-fired turbine_ that makes _Forge Energy_: enough for an _Electric Motor_ at _16,384 SU_.
Burns _20 mB_ of _lava_ a second for _1,024 FE_ a tick, and pushes the power out of its _side terminals_. Pipes fill it at the _back_.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.geothermal_cas: The shell of a _Geothermal Turbine_: build a _3x3x3_ of it round a _Turbine Core_, with the _Controller_ in the middle of the front.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.geothermal_cor: The heart of a _Geothermal Turbine_, in the very middle of its _3x3x3_.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.geothermal_con: Forms and runs a _Geothermal Turbine_: _lava_ boils _water_ to steam that turns the turbine, for _46,080 FE_ a tick, enough for _two and a half Electric Motors_ flat out.
Takes _lava_ and _water_ through the _ports under its base_ (_90_ and _250 mB_ a second), and gives power to anything under it or to energy cables there.

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.lava_generato: The Lava Generator: a little lava-fired turbine that makes Forge Energy
Lava goes in at the middle of its back, by pipe or by the bucket
It burns 20 mB a second, and its turbine wheel spins behind the window: the more power is taken, the faster it turns
Power comes out of the terminals in the middle of each side: 1,024 FE a tick, enough for an Electric Motor at 16,384 SU
Pipez energy pipes take its power anywhere. It only burns what's taken, so a light load saves lava
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.electric_moto: The Electric Motor turns Forge Energy into rotation, with up to 294,912 stress units: a full steam boiler's worth
Power goes in through its base, the flange opposite the shaft: here, straight from a Lava Generator
Right-click it with a Wrench to set its speed, its stress and which way it turns
Speed snaps to Create's standard speeds. Stress snaps to what the generators make, so it's easy to match a motor to its supply
The more stress it's set to give, the more power it draws: 1 FE a tick for every 16 SU
Short of power, it stops, and starts again once it has half a second's worth stored
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.geothermal_tu: The Geothermal Turbine is a 3x3x3 machine. Start with a layer of Geothermal Casings...
...with the Turbine Core in the very middle...
The Controller goes in the middle of the front, facing you
Within a second it forms into one big machine
Lava, water and power connect only through the ports under its base: pipe lava and water in from below. The gauges on the front show how much it has of each
Lava boils the water to steam that turns the turbine: 46,080 FE a tick, ten times as much from each bucket of lava as a Lava Generator
It powers anything under its base, or energy cables at the ports there: enough for two and a half Electric Motors flat out
It uses 90 mB of lava and 250 mB of water a second: two fully upgraded Lava Wellsprings keep it going
block.comedymonkeysaddons.auto_harvester: A sealed _planter_ that grows a crop or tree and harvests it again and again. The plant itself is _never used up_.
Use a _seed_, _crop_ or _sapling_ on it to plant it. Empty-handed, use takes the harvest out and _sneak_-use takes the plant back.

Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_ (the window faces you when placed). It always uses the same stress (_512 SU_ by default) and runs _no faster_ for more speed: enchant it with _Bountiful_ to grow faster.
Holds nine stacks of harvest, taken out by _hoppers_, _chutes_, _funnels_, pipes or arms from any side. When full it _stops_ and puts _no stress_ on the network.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.cuckoo_clock.t: A Black Forest _wall clock_, two blocks tall, that keeps the village to _set restock times_.
Needs a _shaft_ into the middle of its _back_, usually through the wall it hangs on. It always uses the same stress (_1024 SU_ by default, a windmill of about 16 sails) at any speed.
Villagers within _64 blocks_ (by default) restock at _8:00_ and _12:00_ game time, on their first trip to their workstation after the hour. Villagers further away keep the vanilla times.
At 8:00 and 12:00 it _chimes_, a carved villager rolls out with a _workstation_ from the hall, and the _cuckoo_ calls the hour.

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.trade_bot.tex: Trade Bot comes docked in his winding station: place them as one. He's yours, and only you and your team can give him jobs
Feed Forge Energy in from underneath, through a cable or a generator that outputs upward. The station stores 100,000 FE
While he's docked it winds him up, 64 FE a tick. A full charge of 100,000 FE carries him around 25,000 blocks
A redstone signal keeps him at home
A comparator reads 5 while he's home, 10 while he's out working, and 15 when he needs you: low on charge, or run down
Engineer's Goggles on the station show his charge, what he's doing, his containers and today's trades
Sneak-click the station with a Wrench to pack him back into one item, jobs and all. Nothing else can break it
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.trade_bot_lin: Right-click his station for its screen: his charge, his containers, and buttons to Select containers or Call him home
Select containers, then right-click containers out in the world. The first click makes one an input, that he takes goods from
Click one again to make it his output, if he hasn't got one yet
He takes up to 4 inputs and 1 output, within 64 blocks. Left-click one to unlink it; sneak, or click his station, when you're done. A belt can only be an output
His output only ever gets his earnings: emeralds, and Nuggets of Experience for the trades' XP. Whatever doesn't sell goes back where it came from
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.trade_bot_tra: He sells to villagers sitting on Create Seats, and to wandering traders: any that buy what's in his inputs, within 64 blocks of his station
When there's a sale to make he sets off by himself, by day, taking only what they'll buy
He trades from two blocks away, across the villager's workstation
In one go he makes every trade he can pay for, at the villager's real prices and stock. Each trade makes him a better price next time
Villagers earn XP and level up as usual, and any new trades that opens up he sells on the same trip
Then he delivers his emeralds, and Nuggets of Experience for the trades' XP, puts back what didn't sell, and docks
Hostile mobs frighten him, and with no health left he winds down. He never dies: wind him back up with a Wrench
The Cuckoo Clock hangs on a wall, two blocks tall: the clock, with its pendulum and weights below
Its shaft goes into the middle of its back, usually through the wall. It always uses 1,024 SU by default, about a 16-sail windmill
The hands keep the game's time, and the window shows the sun and moon crossing the sky
While it turns, villagers within 64 blocks (by default) restock at 8:00 and 12:00, on their next trip to their workstation
As the hour comes round it chimes, a carved villager rolls out with a workstation from nearby, and the cuckoo calls the hour
Engineer's Goggles show the time, when the next restock is, and how many villagers it reaches

On an _Animal Pen_: it moves in. On the ground: the animal is let out and you get the Capture Bottle back.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.animal_pen.too: Keeps _one captured animal_ and breeds it up: their drops, wool, eggs and milk without a mob farm.

Use a _Bottled Animal_ on it, then put its _breeding food_ in (by hand or funnel). With a _shaft_ turning in the _back_, every _five minutes_ each adult eats one food and has a baby; babies _grow up_ in twenty minutes, as in vanilla. Up to _128_.

Use a _sword_ to take _half the adults_ (rounded, never the last) and their drops; Looting and Fire Aspect count. _Shears_ shear every adult sheep; a _bucket_ takes milk. The _young_ are left to grow up. _Deployers_ can do all of it.
While it turns, chickens lay eggs, sheep regrow wool and cows make milk for pipes. It always uses the same stress (_256 SU_ by default), at any speed.
Opens its screen: take the animal back out (the rest are butchered into its output), and see its food, milk and what it has made.

While it turns, chickens lay eggs, sheep regrow wool and cows make milk for pipes. It always uses the same stress (_1,024 SU_ by default), at any speed.
